name: North Kolkata Heritage
vibe: Bonedi bari, Kumartuli artisans, and the oldest sarbojanin pujas. Narrow lanes, deep tradition.
walk_tip: Take the Blue Line to Sovabazar or Shyambazar. The lanes off Rabindra Sarani and Bidhan Sarani are closed to cars most evenings.

name: Central Blockbusters
vibe: Theme giants: Md. Ali Park, College Square and Santosh Mitra Square. Huge queues and huge spectacle.
walk_tip: Use MG Road, Central or Sealdah. Go before 8 am or after 1 am if you want short queues.

name: Gariahat & Ballygunge
vibe: Ekdalia, Singhi Park and Ballygunge Cultural. Classic South Kolkata grandeur with lots of food around.
walk_tip: Park at South City or Quest and walk the Gariahat loop. Gariahat Road becomes one-way after 4 pm.

name: Lake Market & Kalighat
vibe: Tridhara, 66 Pally, Maddox Square, Badamtala and Chetla. The densest cluster in the city.
walk_tip: The Blue Line stations Kalighat, Rabindra Sarobar and Jatin Das Park all drop you right into the cluster. Lake Mall has paid parking.

name: Behala & New Alipore
vibe: Suruchi Sangha, Barisha and Behala Notun Dal. Theme-heavy and a little less crowded.
walk_tip: The Purple Line runs from Taratala to Behala Chowrasta. Cars are fine before 5 pm.

name: Salt Lake Blocks
vibe: FD, BJ and AE Blocks. Wide roads, well organised, family friendly.
walk_tip: Green Line to City Centre. Cars are OK, and City Centre has paid parking.

name: Lake Town & Dum Dum Park
vibe: Sreebhumi and the Dum Dum Park theme row. Insta-famous replicas and art installations.
walk_tip: VIP Road jams up for kilometres around Sreebhumi. Take the metro to Dum Dum and then an auto, or park at Diamond Plaza.
